close_reason: Opinion: two constructors is clearer than Option<impl Into<String>>; unifying would require callers to write Some(...). Closed as opinion.
description: Having unknown_capability() and unknown_capability_with_detail() is two constructors for the same logical state. The design choice is: 'always provide the URI (detail is not optional)' or 'URI is optional'. If the URI should always be provided at the call site (the right answer for this codebase), unknown_capability() should be removed or replaced with a single constructor that requires the URI. If optional, a single fn unknown_capability(uri: Option<impl Into<String>>) would unify them. The current split invites callers to reach for the easy no-detail version.
title: two unknownCapability constructors: Option<impl Into<String>> would unify them
